concept.title: Applying the classification every night
concept.shortdesc: Each night, new and changed listings are restated, shortlisted, judged and, where necessary, escalated or logged.

conbody.p: The second job is routine and automatic. Each night the harvester picks up listings that are new or have changed. For each one:

ol.li: Restate. The same language model fills in the same form.
Shortlist. The listing's position on the map is compared with the position of each category's definition, and the ten nearest categories are taken.

Judge. The language model chooses from that shortlist, applying each category's includes and excludes. It gives one main category and at most two others, quotes its evidence, and says how confident it is. It is allowed to answer “none of these”.
Escalate. If confidence is low, or the shortlist and the judge disagree, the case goes to a stronger model.
Log what does not fit. Listings that match no category are recorded as suggestions for the next version of the classification.
